# Check for missing values in batting_average
print("Total number of players:", len(df))
print("Missing batting averages (NaN):", df['batting_average'].isna().sum())
print("Players with recorded batting average:", df['batting_average'].notna().sum())

# Filter players with recorded batting average
df_with_ba = df[df['batting_average'].notna()]

# Calculate mean batting average
mean_ba = df_with_ba['batting_average'].mean()
print("\nMean batting average (before rounding):", mean_ba)

# Round to three decimal places
mean_ba_rounded = round(mean_ba, 3)
print("Mean batting average (rounded to 3 decimal places):", mean_ba_rounded)

# Format the answer as required
answer = f"@mean_batting_average[{mean_ba_rounded}]"
print("\nFinal answer:", answer)
